products.name: Compact Two Level Acrylic Pen Stand
products.description: A compact clear acrylic pen stand with two notched support levels for separating and presenting writing instruments. The open rack keeps individual pens visible and accessible on a desk or display counter. Contact Roshan Industries to confirm the required pen fit, layout and order quantity.
products.note: Please contact Roshan Industries to confirm the required variant, application, quantity and quotation.
products.existingProductComparison: Distinct from RIT-0261: compact bent rack with two notched supports rather than a pipette rack on a separate footed base.

products.name: Six Position Acrylic Pen Display Stand
products.description: A clear acrylic pen display stand with six upper support slots and corresponding openings in the base. The angled support presents writing instruments in separate positions for desk organisation or counter display. Contact Roshan Industries to confirm pen compatibility and the quantity required.
products.note: Please contact Roshan Industries to confirm the required variant, application, quantity and quotation.
products.existingProductComparison: Distinct from RIT-0260: six positions rather than the eight-position stand already listed.

products.name: Clear Acrylic Earring Display Stand
products.description: A clear acrylic earring display stand with a perforated panel and a bent base for countertop presentation. The open hole layout helps arrange studs and suitable hanging earrings while keeping each item visible for selection. Contact Roshan Industries to confirm the required hole layout, display size and quantity.
